brief:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has rejected a comprehensive Gaza peace proposal presented by U.S. President Donald Trump, according to Al Jazeera English. The plan, which comprises 15 specific points, was offered as a framework for resolving the ongoing conflict in Gaza and establishing a path toward settlement.

Netanyahu's rejection represents a significant point of disagreement between the Israeli government and the Trump administration over the terms and conditions necessary to end the war. The prime minister did not publicly detail his specific objections to the proposal or outline which elements of the plan he found unacceptable. The rejection underscores persistent tensions between Israel and the United States over the direction of negotiations and the shape of any eventual Gaza settlement.
dek: Israel rejects Trump’s 15-point Gaza plan, Netanyahu says.
title: Netanyahu rejects Trump's 15-point Gaza peace plan
